title: KAPPA: Checking the Proofs in Statistics Papers with Lean 4 and Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Papers in statistical theory rest on long proofs that few readers check line by line. We present KAPPA (Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant), open-source software that organizes language model agents, run by Claude Code, to translate the proofs of a LaTeX paper into the proof assistant Lean 4 with its library Mathlib and check them there, result by result. Each numbered result receives one of four verdicts: verified unconditionally; verified conditionally, with every cited or unproved input stated as a named hypothesis; issue recorded, with its place in the paper and the side at fault; or unfinished, with the reason. The kit follows the paper's own proof step by step, rather than finding a new one. Separate agents write and review, each statement is compared with the paper before it is proved and fingerprinted afterwards, and every verdict rests on evidence that can be rerun without a language model. translated_title: KAPPA：利用 Lean 4 与语言模型智能体核查统计学论文中的证明
translated_abstract: 统计理论领域的论文依赖于冗长的证明，很少有读者会逐行核对。我们提出了 KAPPA（Kit of Agents for Proof-checking Papers with a proof Assistant，即借助证明助手的论文证明核查智能体工具包），这是一套开源软件，它组织由 Claude Code 运行的语言模型智能体，将 LaTeX 论文中的证明逐条结果地翻译到证明助手 Lean 4 及其数学库 Mathlib 中，并在其中进行核查。每个编号结果会得到四种判定之一：无条件验证通过；有条件验证通过（所有引用或未证明的前提均明确列为命名假设）；记录问题（注明其在论文中的位置及责任方）；或未完成（注明原因）。该工具包严格跟随论文自身的证明逐步核查，而非另寻新的证明。独立的智能体分别负责撰写与审查，每个陈述在证明前都与论文原文比对，并在之后进行指纹化处理，且每项判定都基于无需语言模型即可重新运行的证据。
tldr: 该论文提出了开源系统 KAPPA，利用由 Claude Code 编排的语言模型智能体将统计学论文中的证明自动翻译到 Lean 4 证明助手并逐条核查，对每个结果给出四种判定之一，且所有判定均基于无需语言模型即可复现的证据。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces KAPPA, an open-source system that orchestrates language model agents via Claude Code to translate proofs in statistics papers into the Lean 4 proof assistant and verify them result by result, issuing one of four verdicts for each result, with every verdict backed by evidence that can be rerun without a language model.
